results.title: Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram
results.content:
K-pop has exploded from a South Korean craze in the early 2000s to a global phenomenon. Icons like BTS, Blackpink, and 2NE1 are topping the US Billboard charts and even lighting up stages at festivals like Coachella. Social media has been a game-changer in this rise. In South Korea, 24% of internet users follow influencers, 19.2% track actors and performers, and 12% follow bands and musicians (DataReportal). This online engagement keeps fans connected to their favorite idols' personal and professional moments, fueling K-pop's worldwide virality.
K-Pop idols hold significant influence in marketing, as fans seek to connect with their lifestyle and endorsed products. The trust and loyalty between idols and their fans extend to brands, making social media and influencer marketing top trends in South Korea. We've curated a list of the most-followed K-Pop idols on Instagram to help you effectively promote your brand in this market.
Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram ⬇️
Let's talk about Lay Zhang, hands down one of the most famous K-Pop idols and a total superstar! This multi-talented icon is a rapper, singer, songwriter, record producer, dancer, actor, and entrepreneur all rolled into one. Evolving from EXO's dancer in 2012, he has now taken creative authority, storyboarding his own music videos and directing his cinematic album rollout, Flawed Crown.
On social media, his Instagram grid is less like a celebrity billboard, allowing his audiences to look into his edgy, creative mind. He combines high-concept visuals with futuristic aesthetics and warm, humorous snippets from his life that somehow still feel human.
Followers: About 15.3 million
If you're looking for a solo artist who's not afraid to be daring, then look no further than Kim Hyun-ah, better known as Hyuna. She's a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, and model who first debuted as a member of the girl group Wonder Girls back in February 2007. But in 2010, she struck out on her own with a performance-oriented music style that has since won her a huge following.
What keeps audiences refreshing her feed is not just her high fashion shoots or celeb glam, but how she blends them with bare-faced, unfiltered moments from her daily life. She is not afraid to be candid with her followers, sharing about how she is going through health struggles or performance exhaustion. This makes her one of the few idols who uses her platform as a living diary of someone navigating real life.
15. Yoona - Girls' Generation
Followers: About 18.5 million
If you're a fan of top K-Pop girl groups, you definitely know Yoona from Girls' Generation! She's not only a singer but also a talented actress from South Korea. Yoona debuted in August 2007 with Girls' Generation, one of South Korea's best-selling and most popular female groups, transitioning into a solo album and critically acclaimed television and film roles.
On social media, she effortlessly shifts from sharing high-fashion editorial posts to simple lifestyle content such as baking treats at home and documenting her travels. These unscripted moments and personal milestones make her feed less stiff, balancing her star power with approachability.
Who hasn’t heard of BamBam? As one of the most popular idols in K-Pop, BamBam is celebrated for his skills as a Thai rapper, singer, songwriter, and record producer. A standout member of the K-Pop boy band GOT7, he has recently released his first-ever album in Thai language, "HOMETOWN" EP, in late 2025. He frequently shares his insights into music concepts and fashion campaigns online, while interacting directly with fans with charm and openness.
Kim Tae-yeon is surely one of the most popular K-Pop idols around. First stealing hearts as a member of the iconic Girls' Generation, she's now slaying it as a solo artist with over a million albums and twenty million singles.
While she is a true vocal powerhouse, Taeyeon is known to avoid the untouchable idol image. On her personal Instagram, she transparently posts about behind-the-scenes as well as her personal struggles. She can seamlessly pivot from highly glam content with cosmetic brands to a 'homebody' who enjoys relaxful moments at home with her dog and her gaming hobby.
You might know Suzy as a South Korean actress and solo singer, but did you know she actually started her career as a member of the girl group miss A? Since debuting with them in 2010, she has launched her solo recording career and became an A-list actress. No wonder she was named the first female celebrity in Korean history to win rookie awards across all four major entertainment sectors: Music, Television, Film, and Variety!
With her stellar achievements, Suzy maintains a genuinely warm and humble online presence, bridging the gap between a global superstar and a relatable friend. This keeps her fandom, the Sueweeties, attuned to her content, where she often shares casual moments from her daily life in addition to elegant editorial campaigns.
Get hyped for one of the biggest K-Pop stars ever: Kwon Ji-yong, aka G-Dragon! Known as the "King of K-Pop," this South Korean rapper, singer-songwriter, and fashion designer is a total icon. G-Dragon burst onto the scene in 2006 as the leader of Big Bang, and he's been shaking up culture, fashion, and music ever since.
His fiercely loyal fandom (VIPs) are familiar with how he balances mystique-driven trending content with a deeply intimate and artistic vulnerability. Instead of following standard social media expectations, he often posts blurry, abstract photos that speak volumes of his creative side. He still shares unedited moments from his career, humanizing his persona and making him an irreplaceable force among K-idols.
Username: @jacksonwang852g7
Followers: About 32.3 million
Jackson Wang is a multitalented artist hailing from Hong Kong. A multi-talented rapper, singer, fashion designer, dancer, and TV host, he's a member of both the South Korean boy group GOT7 and the Chinese hip-hop group Panthepack. Over the years, he's solidified his impact as an artist and global fashion entrepreneur.
What truly makes his digital presence compelling is his openness. On Instagram, his content is highly cinematic with an avant-garde aesthetic, but scroll over to TikTok and YouTube and you'll find his hilarious, chaotic side. His content ranges from street interviews to sharing raw moments of self-doubt and creative burnout as an artist, engaging fans with his humanness.
You may have heard of IU - a talented South Korean singer-songwriter, record producer, and actress. With her stage name being a combination of "I" and "you", symbolizing the connection between her and her fans through music, IU is admired for her girl-next-door charm and incredible vocal range, even earning the title of "The Nation's Sweetheart".
Apart from her talent, what makes IU beloved by her fans is the joyful interaction she builds with them online. Her grid is filled with bare selfies, casual vacation recaps and behind-the-scenes, and other authentic moments. She also often shares trivial everyday struggles such as skin issues or complaining about the weather. Directly engaging with fans on community boards and her feed, she presents herself as a caring older sister checking up on loved ones.
Cha Eun-woo is a triple threat - he's a famous singer, actor, and model from South Korea. He's part of the boy group Astro, releasing his solo debut EP “Entity” in 2024. He has also secured high-profile ambassadorships with luxury fashion and beauty brands such as Dior and Burberry - talk about a fashion icon!
Eun-woo’s online persona balances high-fashion elegance with minimalistic personal sharing. Instead, he allows the strong visual content to communicate with his audience directly, while also occasionally sharing polished snapshots from his filming sets and travels.
If you're all about K-pop, you definitely know RM, the leader of BTS. He's not just another rapper; he's a songwriting and producing genius behind many of the group's hits. Originally known as "Rap Monster" (pretty fitting, right?), RM was even spotlighted on XXL’s "10 Korean Rappers You Should Know" list. His highly praised solo albums peaked on charts, and his indie project "Right Place, Wrong Person", was named the No. 1 K-Pop Album of 2024.
Deliberately posting sparingly and closing the comments section for most of them, he designed his Instagram to look like a digital archive, aligning with his username. Instead, RM is known to use Instagram Stories for day-to-day casual updates and music recommendations, allowing him to still engage with his fans.
Jimin is one of the talented members of the K-pop sensation BTS, admired for his mesmerizing dance style and distinct vocal range. But did you know that he is also the fastest K-pop soloist to have a track surpass 1 billion streams on Spotify with his single "Who" in just 118 days?
Like other BTS members, Jimin is also highly selective about permanent posts and online activity, often maintaining a small amount of content on his feed. However, he evokes emotional intimacy and warmth when communicating with his fans through Instagram Stories. He is known to check in on his fans' well-being and write deeply emotional messages, nurturing an intensely loyal digital audience.
Jin, also known as Kim Seok-jin, is a South Korean singer and songwriter. He debuted as a member of the South Korean boy band BTS in 2013. In 2024, after completing his military service, Jin became the first BTS member to return from enlistment, and his debut solo studio mini-album “Happy” officially surpassed 1 million sales.
Online, he is affectionately dubbed "Worldwide Handsome" by both himself and the media. His feed is a mix of on-stage moments and unedited photos from his daily life without following a highly calculated artistic layout. He is also known to be playful and lighthearted, keeping his online presence focused on spreading happiness to his audience.
Jisoo from Blackpink is a record-breaking solo musician and award-winning actress. She is also famously credited as the global brand ambassador of Dior and Cartier, where she is acclaimed for driving massive revenue for the brands.
Her online presence maintains an intentional balance between elegantly curated photos and an endearing personality. As one of the most-followed Korean actresses on Instagram, she frequently shows off her quirky personality through casual cozy vlogs on her YouTube channel.
Username: @roses_are_rosie
Roseanne Park, famously known as Rosé, is a Korean-New Zealand singer and dancer who has captivated global audiences. Rosé joined South Korean label YG Entertainment after a successful audition in 2012, eventually debuting as a member of the girl group Blackpink in August 2016. Her influence extends beyond music, having been the global ambassador of luxury brands such as YSL and Tiffany & Co.
On social media, she is known to establish a Parisian chic aesthetic, setting international styling trends with her looks and outfits. Rosé also shares a playful and soft side that fans adore, posting casual mirror selfies as well as travel and food content. This approach transforms her social accounts into a welcoming space for followers to feel like her close friends.
Username: @jennierubyjane
Jennie from Blackpink is known for her smooth vocals and impressive rapping skills. Being a versatile musical artist and fashion trendsetter, she has been named in TIME's 100 Most Influential People in the World.
Jennie’s digital content often features artistic visuals that range from balletcore trends to casual street-style looks. She balances this high-glam aesthetic with a warm personality on her YouTube vlogs and TikTok posts, showing her real-life "Jendeukie" side, where she is known to be a soft-spoken and pet-loving persona by her audience.
Lisa, or Lalisa Manoban, the dancing queen of Blackpink, is one of the most famous K-pop idols. Her mesmerizing moves captivate fans worldwide. In September 2021, Lisa made her record-breaking solo debut with the album Lalisa, selling an impressive 736,000 copies in its first week. A true style icon, Lisa has collaborated with major brands like AIS, Samsung, Adidas, MAC, Bulgari, and Celine.
As one of the most followed Asian celebrities on Instagram, she effortlessly shifts between dramatic, high-glam posts to snapshots from her luxury travels. This sense of effortlessness makes her lifestyle appear completely natural and engaging.
Instagram has become an essential marketing platform for K-Pop groups and solo artists. Instagram empowers fans to take a sneak peek into their idols' personal lives, and to take a look at their lifestyle outside the cameras and the stage lights. K-Pop idols also use this platform to truly connect with their loyal followers.
Blackpink is a famous example of how to use Instagram to connect with fans, promote music, and share little glimpses of life beyond the spotlight. It's no surprise that all four members have snagged the top spots on the platform, engaging millions of followers worldwide.
Instagram's personal character humanizes K-Pop idols, making them more reachable and authentic to the public eye. The idols' posts allows fans to know how these artists live their lives, what they eat, what they use, and where they buy products. This is also why influencer marketing collaborations with K-Pop stars have risen as one of the best ways to promote a brand in South Korea.
We hope this list has helped you in your research on the top K-Pop idols you could work with on your campaign.

The most followed K-Pop idols on Instagram include BLACKPINK members Lisa, Jennie, Rosé, and Jisoo, along with BTS members like Jimin and RM. These idols have millions of followers due to their global fame.

TL;DR: The most-followed Instagram account in 2026 is Instagram’s official account, with 685 million followers. Other popular accounts include Cristiano Ronaldo, Leo Messi, and Selena Gomez.
What are the most-followed Instagram accounts in 2026?
The official Instagram account is currently the most-followed Instagram account. Here’s a breakdown* of the entire top 10.
Account — Country — Followers
1. Instagram — United States — 685 million
2. Cristiano Ronaldo — Portugal — 678 million
3. Leo Messi — Argentina — 515 million
4. Selena Gomez — United States — 404 million
5. Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson — United States — 382 million
6. Kylie Jenner — United States — 381 million
7. Ariana Grande — United States — 363 million
8. Kim Kardashian — United States — 344 million
9. Beyoncé — United States — 299 million
10. Khloé Kardashian — United States — 292 million
1. Instagram – 685 million followers
The social media giant boasts millions more followers than anyone else mentioned here, and is the only brand on the list. But why?
It helps that the official Instagram account has been active since early 2012, around a year after the platform launched. At the time, Insta had more than 10 million monthly active users — that might not sound like much compared with today’s 3 billion, but the competition was smaller. If you were on the platform back in the day, chances are you followed this account.
But that can’t sustain growth for more than a decade. The official Instagram account thrives on a blend of content covering platform-based updates, up-and-coming creators, topical posts, celebrity- and influencer-endorsed posts, and good old-fashioned memes. Instagram is the most-followed Instagram account? It makes sense.
2. Cristiano Ronaldo – 678 million followers
While he’s not the most-followed account, Cristiano Ronaldo is comfortably the most-followed user on Instagram. The Portuguese footballer publishes a regular smattering of personal content, sponsored posts, and training footage.
It doesn’t hurt when he collabs with some of the internet’s biggest names, either. In late 2024, he dropped a video with the world’s most-subscribed YouTuber, MrBeast.
3. Leo Messi – 515 million followers
The second most-followed person on Instagram is another footballer. Leo Messi is one of the GOATs, and similar to Ronaldo, his account’s peppered with sponsored content, training footage, and the occasional personal post here and there.
4. Selena Gomez – 404 million followers
Selena Gomez is more than whatever you think she is. Whether you know her for her music, acting, cosmetics brand, mental health advocacy, or other charity work, she covers all bases.
Her Instagram reflects that. One day, you might see a glossy magazine shoot, stills from a roundtable interview, or a carousel of her latest press trip. The next day, it could be a behind-the-scenes clip from her makeup business, Rare Beauty, or candid snapshots with her family.
5. Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson – 382 million followers
People love Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson. Even though he made his name beating people to a pulp, audiences couldn’t get enough of his charismatic, quippy energy. That charm has carried his Hollywood career, delighting viewers with a well-placed one-liner or a raise of the eyebrow.
The Rock’s Insta feed does numbers because it’s so clearly him behind it. He writes honestly about box office figures, workouts, award ceremonies, and more. You don’t have to scroll long before you see him mingling with fans — he puts the time in with the people who matter, which just makes them love him more.
6. Kylie Jenner – 381 million followers
Similar to Gomez, Kylie Jenner can be classed as many things: socialite, influencer, businesswoman. Unlike Gomez, Jenner’s popularity often stems from controversy. That comes as no surprise for a member of the Kardashian-Jenner family, but her account is popular for a reason — she sells a lifestyle.
Jenner’s sponsored posts and branded content usually arrive in the form of a selfie or photoshoot carousel, urging followers to check out the latest drop. It’s a great strategy, keeping her business, family, and personal brand in the spotlight.
7. Ariana Grande – 363 million followers
Ariana Grande’s popularity can’t be overstated. She’s a pop star, sure — she also took the world by storm with Wicked, does mountains of charity work, and founded her own makeup line, r.e.m. beauty.
She posts the usual mixture of business and pleasure, but when Grande’s promoting a new project, you can’t move for it. Check out her feed during the Wicked press cycles — if you find anything other than pink dresses and green witches, you’ve got better eyes than us.
8. Kim Kardashian – 344 million followers
Everyone knows who Kim Kardashian is, and everyone has an opinion. She’s the definition of “influencer,” however you choose to use that term. But the way she wields that influence is what makes her one of the most-followed people on Instagram. Just look at what she’s done for awareness of the Armenian genocide and US criminal justice reform.
Like Jenner, Kardashian’s feed offers aspiration. It doesn’t matter if she’s posting creepy Halloween outfits, advertising her Beats collab, or driving sales for her shapewear brand, Skims — she’s got your attention, regardless of your opinion. The fact that she’s sustained this popularity throughout and beyond The Kardashians’ TV run is testament to Kim K’s staying power.
9. Beyoncé – 299 million followers
There’s a noticeable trend running through this list: pretty much everyone has more than one hustle. Beyoncé is a music icon in her own right, and that’s before you even consider her philanthropy, business ventures, and filmmaking.
Beyoncé revolutionized the music industry, and people want to know how she does things — what makes her tick? You’re unlikely to find the secret sauce on her Instagram, but a carefully curated grab-bag of self-portraits, professional shoots, promo materials, and candids is more than enough.
10. Khloé Kardashian – 292 million followers
Khloé Kardashian draws the most-followed on Instagram list to a close, and she’s no slouch. The media personality’s business ventures, family snaps, and more drive home that larger-than-life quality shared with the rest of her family.
What do all of these accounts have in common? Instagram itself aside, they’re all massive celebrities — people you could pick from a police lineup without a moment’s hesitation. It’s a far cry from the most-subscribed and -viewed YouTube channels, which range from national broadcasters and wrestling companies to gaming influencers and kids’ content.
But that’s fine. Even if you or your brand never hit Beyoncé numbers, you can still be wildly successful and create content that lasts.

Frequently asked questions about the most-followed people on Instagram
Who has the most followers on Instagram?
Instagram’s own official account has the most followers on Instagram, with 685 million as of August 2026. Cristiano Ronaldo is second with 678 million, followed by Leo Messi with 515 million. Instagram’s account is the only brand in the top 10; every other account belongs to a celebrity.
Who is the most-followed user on Instagram?
Cristiano Ronaldo is the most-followed user on Instagram, with 678 million followers as of August 2026. The only account ahead of him is Instagram’s own official account, which is a brand page rather than a user. This makes Ronaldo the most-followed individual person on the platform.
Why does Instagram’s own account have the most followers?
Instagram’s official account has been active since early 2012, roughly a year after the platform launched. As a result, it gained followers from the earliest user base. It also posts consistently: platform updates, emerging creators, celebrity and influencer content, and memes.
Where do the most-followed Instagram accounts come from?
Eight of the most-followed Instagram accounts are based in the United States. Cristiano Ronaldo and Leo Messi are the only non-US entries.
Who is the second-most-followed person on Instagram?
Leo Messi is the second-most-followed person on Instagram, with 515 million followers as of August 2026. He sits behind Cristiano Ronaldo, who has 678 million. Messi is third overall on the most-followed list, as Instagram’s own brand page ranks above both footballers with 685 million followers.
Who has the most followers on Instagram ever?
Instagram’s official account holds the highest follower count in the platform’s history at 685 million. Cristiano Ronaldo holds the record for an individual user at 678 million. Ronaldo was the first person to pass 500 million followers, in November 2022; and the first person to reach 600 million followers, in August 2023.
Which brand has the most followers on Instagram?
Instagram’s own account is the most-followed brand page on Instagram, with 685 million followers. It’s also the only brand in the platform’s overall top 10. Nike is the second-most-followed brand, with 291 million followers.
How many followers do you need to be in the Instagram top 10?
You need roughly 292 million followers to make Instagram’s top 10, which is Khloé Kardashian’s count at number 10 as of August 2026.
How often does the most-followed Instagram list change?
The ranking order rarely changes, but the follower numbers change constantly. Any published list is a snapshot, and this list is updated weekly. The top three positions, Instagram, Cristiano Ronaldo, and Leo Messi, have been stable for years. The other positions shift more often, and gaps there can be as small as a few million.
* Data and rankings updated August 3, 2026

results.title: Most followers on Instagram for a K-pop artist | Guinness World Records
results.content:
BLACKPINK singer/rapper Lisa (Thailand, b. Pranpriya Manobal; @lalalalisa_m) is the most followed K-pop star on Instagram, with 90,739,796 followers as of 24 March 2023. All four individual members of South Korea’s BLACKPINK have around 70 million followers on Instagram, while the group as a whole have racked up some 54 million followers.
While she’s ranked below female musicians like Selena Gomez, Ariana Grande and Beyoncé, Lisa has more followers than any K-pop act and more followers than any musician – male or female – outside the Americas. Her nearest rival, Dua Lipa, had 87,744,852 Instagram followers as of the same date.

results.title: The Top 10 Most Followed K-Pop Idols On Instagram In 2026 - Koreaboo
results.content:
K-Pop idols are some of the most influential celebrities on social media, and Instagram is one of the main ways they connect with fans around the world. Through photos, videos, and behind-the-scenes moments, idols share glimpses of their music, fashion, travels, and daily lives. Here are the Top 10 Most Followed K-Pop Idols on Instagram in 2026.
First up is Cha Eunwoo with 47.3M followers. He often posts photos and reels about his music and acting work, fashion shoots, travel, and lifestyle content.
Suga has 51.8M followers. He posts thoughtful snapshots, music‑related updates, and artistic photos that reflect his creative identity.
Jin has 52.6M followers. He often posts casual snapshots, behind‑the‑scenes moments, and silly photos that show his fun-loving personality.
J-Hope has 53.5M followers. His bright, colorful content includes dance clips, performance highlights, and stylish fashion moments.
Jimin has 56M followers. His elegant, carefully curated photos often feature onstage performances, fashion, and his personal style.
V has 70.5M followers, making him the most-followed male idol. He often posts visually artistic shots from pictorials, creative photography, and content related to his interests: music. traveling, and art.
Jisoo has 80.5M followers. She often posts stylish photoshoots, brand collabs, and behind‑the‑scenes moments.
Rosé currently has 84.5M followers. She posts aesthetic photos, music updates, fashion moments with designer brands, and snaps from her daily life.
Jennie has 89.7M followers. Her content includes high‑fashion photos, polished editorial content, casual personal snaps, and luxury brand collaborations.
With 107M followers, Lisa is the most-followed K-Pop idol so far in 2026. Her follower count is more than double South Korea’s entire population (approximately 51.7 million).

results.title: Top 10 most followed K-pop artists on Spotify in 2026 - RouteNote Blog
results.content:
The most popular K-pop artists are dominating around the world and Spotify is one of the best places to find South Korean artists. Here are the top ten most-followed K-pop groups and solo artists as of July 2026.
The time of K-pop dominance is now. K-pop has been growing in recent years and the most popular groups such as BTS and BLACKPINK have been topping charts on their home turf and across the globe.
In 2022 Spotify said worldwide K-pop streams were averaging 7.97bn monthly plays. This was up 27% from the year before. It’s been five years since Spotify launched its service in South Korea, and its K-pop playlists are incredibly popular.
With all this in mind, we wanted to highlight the top K-pop groups and solo artists on Spotify in 2026.
BTS holds the crown for the most-followed K-pop band on Spotify, with over 87 million followers. BLACKPINK are the most-followed K-pop girlband, with over 60 million followers. V has over 21 million followers and is the most-followed K-pop solo artist.
Since we last updated this list earlier this year, BLACKPINK member JENNIE has slightly edged ahead of fellow band member and Bruno Mars collaborator ROSÉ, with over 15 million followers. JENNIE is the only solo artist currently on the top ten to not originate from boy band BTS.
